title: Attainment by a Singleton Coalition
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $i$ be one of its coordinates, let $b\in\{-1,1\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. A coalition consisting only of coordinate $i$ can make $f$ equal $b$ from $x$ if and only if at least one of the two inputs obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$ or to $-1$ has function value $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is an input in the sign cube
